title: Awethu Forestry
schemaName: Awethu Forestry — Brand Identity and Website
metaTitle: Awethu Forestry Brand Identity & Website — Case Study | Santi Universe
description: Awethu Forestry brand identity and website: a tree-and-handshake logo, a nature-inspired colour system, brand applications and a live digital presence.

hero.alt: Awethu Forestry concept: branded entrance sign at the edge of a pine forest
hero.caption: Entrance sign · concept mockup

chapters.label: The idea
heading: A story of
shared growth.
text: The Awethu Forestry presentation centres on collaboration, sustainability and collective responsibility. It describes a brand whose story reaches beyond trees and timber to the people and partnerships connected to the land.
The identity concept brings that direction into a visual language: a handshake, a tree and an expressive palette drawn from nature.

images.alt: Awethu Forestry logo over a forest canopy, framed by green and yellow graphic ribbons
images.caption: Identity over the canopy

images.alt: Awethu Forestry wordmark and tree-handshake symbol on a warm ivory background
images.caption: Wordmark and symbol

chapters.label: The mark
heading: Partnership,
in every branch.
text: The symbol combines the gesture of a handshake with the shape of a tree. The tree expresses forestry and growth; the handshake introduces trust, unity and human connection.
Angular forms create a distinctive emblem that works alongside the Awethu wordmark or stands on its own.

images.alt: Logo concept development: a handshake plus a tree becomes the Awethu forest-handshake emblem
images.caption: Concept development

chapters.label: The visual language
heading: Forest tones.
A brighter energy.
text: Deep greens, leafy tones and bright yellow-green accents give the identity both a natural foundation and a lively presence. Warm ivory provides space for the logo and typography.
Flowing graphic ribbons carry those colours across the presentation, framing photography and creating continuity between brand applications.

images.alt: White Awethu Forestry logo on green with flowing ivory, dark-green and yellow-green ribbons
images.caption: Colour system

chapters.label: In application
heading: From the mark
to the everyday.
text: The presentation explores how the identity could extend across stationery and clothing. A notebook, cards and pens bring the system into printed materials; a cap and polo show the mark at a smaller, wearable scale.

chapters.label: Out in the world
heading: A presence
in the landscape.
text: Further concepts explore the identity in the field: entrance signage, a forestry vehicle, workwear and a portable field kit.

chapters.label: The website
heading: From the forest.
To the screen.
text: The website brings Awethu’s identity into a digital setting. Forest imagery, the tree-and-handshake emblem and bright green accents connect the homepage to the wider brand system.
Clear routes to About, Impact, Services, Articles and Contact help visitors explore the business, its forestry services and its latest stories.
